Priya S: Quick check — who owns the remaining postmortem actions from INC-912? Need owners + firm due dates by EOD so we can close the RCA ticket.
Alan K: I can take the KV-cache cleanup item and update the 'runtime caching' runbook. Planning to finish by Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
Mike R: I’ll pick up the A/B traffic routing fix, but need a heads-up from infra on the migration window. @infra-bot can you confirm if we have a maintenance slot this week? :eyes:
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window open Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC. Tagging infra oncall. (ticket: https://ops.redwood/maint/4521)
Sarah L: I own the canary rollback doc and the playbook snippet for circuit-breaker thresholds. Targeting Thu EOD. Will post a PR.
Alan K: @Priya S adding note — I’ll open GH PR with the runbook changes and link here as soon as created (PR #1427).
Priya S: Thanks. Can we consolidate owner/due into a tiny checklist so the PM can close the RCA? I'll paste an action table below.
Priya S: ```
- [ ] KV-cache cleanup — Alan K — Fri EOD
- [ ] A/B routing fix — Mike R — waiting infra slot (Thu window)
- [ ] Canary rollback doc — Sarah L — Thu EOD
- [ ] Alert threshold update — TBD (eng-sre) — Mon EOD
```
Mike R: I’ll ping eng-sre for the alert threshold item and propose an owner. @Sarah L can you note any dependency on the rollback doc for the alert change?
Sarah L: The rollback doc has the recommended thresholds; alert change should wait until my PR lands. I’ll flag the exact line numbers in the PR description.
ops-bot: Created tracker item INC-912-ACTIONS and linked GH PR #1427. Tracker: https://tracker.redwood/INC-912-ACTIONS
Priya S: Perfect. Action items assigned except alert owner — Mike, can you loop in eng-sre and assign before EOD? If we get that, I'll mark RCA ready to close. :spiral_calendar:
